title: CatCert: Automated Quality-Control, Vacuum Thickness, Dipole Correction, and Surface Energy Convergence Certification for Heterogeneous Catalysis & DFT Surface Slabs
description: An open-source toolkit to audit DFT surface slab models, vacuum potential flatness, electrostatic dipole corrections, work functions, and surface energy convergence in heterogeneous catalysis calculations.
